# React 19 patterns with React Compiler — no more manual memoization

Curated by Skill Harbor — @gentleman-programming's react-19: an opinionated React 19 patterns skill built around the React Compiler. Required rules: no manual memoization (the Compiler handles optimization automatically — never hand-write useMemo/useCallback), always named imports from "react", server components first with "use client" only when hooks, event handlers or browser APIs are needed, the use() hook for reading promises and conditional context, actions with useActionState (server actions plus pending state), and ref as a plain prop instead of forwardRef. Honest caveats: compact, single-file guidance — no bundled references; the skill's frontmatter claims Apache-2.0 while the catalog manifest records MIT (manifest takes precedence; a frontmatter/manifest divergence already seen on this repo in lot 42).
